name: Teriyaki Chicken Noodles
method: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Cook the noodles to the packet instructions, drain and set aside.
Heat a wok or large pan until hot and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook for 3 minutes, then pour in the teriyaki sauce and add the noodles.
Toss everything together for 2 minutes until piping hot, then divide between two bowls and serve.
